pr_body:
2988709487df12590eb8c117e8a79317eae660bf changed the proto enum
names for rangelog events related to up/downreplication, which
unfortunately leak into the `system.rangelog` table, breaking
the test due to its reliance on the original names.

Fixes #56406.
Fixes #56412.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/56727)
